target.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

NO_REPLY yield-turn assistant messages with thinking blocks cause a permanent 400 loop after gateway restart. Dropping the NO_REPLY text without the companion thinking block leaves orphaned thinking blocks that merge with adjacent assistant messages into `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]`, which Anthropic rejects as "cannot be modified."

## Evidence

### 1. OpenClaw runtime proof (deterministic, no external API needed)

Ran `normalizeAssistantReplayContent` (the real exported function, not mocked) on both `origin/main` (before fix) and this PR branch (after fix):

Input: `user → assistant[thinking, "NO_REPLY"] → assistant[thinking, "real text"]`

**Before fix (`origin/main`):**
```console
Input count: 3 → Output count: 3
  [0] user types=[text]
  [1] assistant types=[thinking]       ← ORPHANED! thinking block alone
  [2] assistant types=[thinking, text]
Orphaned thinking dropped: false
```
Result: orphaned `[thinking]` message survives → adjacent assistants merge → `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` → Anthropic HTTP 400.

**After fix (PR #99772):**
```console
Input count: 3 → Output count: 2
  [0] user types=[text]
  [1] assistant types=[thinking, text] ← orphaned msg DROPPED
Orphaned thinking dropped: true
User preserved: true
Real assistant preserved: true
ALL PASSED: true
```
Result: orphaned thinking-only assistant removed → clean `[thinking, text]` payload → Anthropic accepts.

### 2. Live API verification (DeepSeek v4-flash via Anthropic-compatible proxy)

Confirmed that the after-fix payload structure `[thinking, text]` is accepted by a live API that supports Anthropic thinking format. Both before-fix payloads (`[thinking, thinking, text]` merged and adjacent assistants) are also syntactically valid — the "cannot be modified" rejection is Anthropic-specific thinking-signature replay enforcement, which the before-fix output would trigger on real Anthropic API.

### 3. Test results

| Suite | Tests | Status |
|---|---|---|
| replay-history.test.ts | 33 (4 new + 29 existing) | All pass |
| thinking.test.ts | 48 | All pass |
| sanitize-session-history.test.ts | 76 | All pass |

## Root Cause

`normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent` drops silent-reply text blocks but preserves companion thinking blocks. When yield artifacts are subsequently cleaned up, two assistants become adjacent. `validateAnthropicTurns` merges them, producing `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` — rejected by Anthropic.

## Risks and Mitigations

- **tool_use companion present**: Guarded — only orphaned thinking (no tool_use, no text) triggers the drop.
- **Compatibility**: No config, env, or migration impact.

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Co-Authored-By**: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
